A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with 29 pages including Appendices A-K. Text and rendered page-body comparisons confirm matching scientific content, equations, tables, and figures without material reading gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original commute-time calculations, VNG benchmark evaluations, and ablations in Section 5 and Appendices H-I, including Tables 1-3 and 6-9.

after.justification: v3 retains the original empirical evaluations and analyses in Section 5 and the appendices, including benchmark performance, smoothing experiments, and attention maps.

M1.justification: The VNG procedure in Section 4, including the local update, virtual-node aggregation, and combination steps in Equations 11-13, is identical. The model formulations in Appendix F also match.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Peptides-Func, Peptides-Struct, MNIST, CIFAR10, MalNet-Tiny, and OGB molhiv, molpcba, and ppa. The appendix analyses retain the same datasets and task coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within Tables 1-3 and 6-9, including GPS and its projection, standard VN models, transformer baselines, and PairNorm variants.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix G retain the same data splits, validation-based checkpoint selection, parameter budgets, training settings, and evaluation procedures. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The commute-time and attention-projection analyses in Section 5.1 are unchanged. Appendices H-I and K retain identical smoothing, PairNorm, backbone, cosine-distance, and attention-map analyses.

E5.justification: The run counts and uncertainty reporting are identical: four runs for peptide benchmarks and ten for other benchmarks, with the same mean and standard-deviation reporting in Tables 2-3 and Appendix G.3.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted findings match across the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 reports the same GatedGCN+PE+VNG CIFAR10 result, 76.080 ± 0.330, in both versions.

T1.justification: Sections 3-4 and Appendices B-F contain identical definitions, assumptions, commute-time and mixing results, sensitivity propositions, polynomial-filter arguments, and proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about spectral characterization of VN benefits, node heterogeneity, and the efficiency and performance of VNG.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning task-dependent heterogeneity and beneficial smoothing are unchanged. The limitations concerning commute-time comparisons with rewiring methods and exploration of message-passing variants are also identical.

D1.justification: Appendix G retains the same single-V100 hardware disclosure, dataset processing descriptions, hyperparameter search ranges, and configuration Tables 4-5. Resource-access information and link targets are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are identical, including comparisons with prior VN, graph-transformer, oversquashing, and PairNorm research.

P1.justification: v3 adds the header 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025' and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Body wording, terminology, section order, and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: A publication-status line appears in the top margin of every page, and the first-page arXiv stamp changes. Figures 1-5, Tables 1-9, captions, and body layout remain identical.

improvement.justification: v3 changes only publication headers and the arXiv stamp. The methods, evidence, proofs, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility details are identical throughout both PDFs, including their appendices, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
